posts.author: Chandler Rome
posts.text: Tatsuya Imai talking about his second and third year is, perhaps, a glimpse into how he is processing his difficult rookie season — or already putting in the past. Imai, however, didn't directly answer whether he planned to opt in to his contract for 2027 - www.nytimes.com/athletic/752...
posts.jp: 今井達也が2年目と3年目について語ることは、彼が難しいルーキーシーズンをどう処理しているか（またはすでに過去のものにしているか）の一端かもしれない。ただし今井は2027年の契約オプトインの予定について直接答えなかった。

posts.author: Mac Cerullo
posts.text: Lars Nootbaar smokes a pinch hit homer into the right field bleachers. D-Backs have scored five unanswered runs to take a 5-2 lead in the sixth.

posts.text: Cubs walk it off against the White Sox for a second consecutive night, this time it's Alex Bregman's RBI single to CF that brings home the winning run in the bottom of the 9th for a 4-3 victory.
posts.jp: カブスがホワイトソックスに対し連夜ウォークオフ勝利。9回裏にアレックス・ブレグマンのCFへの適時打で勝ち越し点が生まれ4-3で勝利。
